claims.text: Timer displays elapsed time in minutes and seconds format (MM:SS)
claims.details: The invariant ensures currentTime is non-negative, which is required for valid time display. ElapsedTimeNonNegative lemma also proves this.

claims.text: A single tap or keypress creates a lap marker at the current elapsed time
claims.details: CreateLap action creates a new Lap with timestamp = currentTime. StepPreservesInv ensures validity is maintained.

claims.text: Each lap records the duration from the previous lap marker (or start) to the current marker
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Apply case CreateLap: duration := m.currentTime - m.lastLapTime
claims.details: CreateLap computes duration as currentTime - lastLapTime, which is the time since the previous lap or start.

claims.text: Sessions are organized hierarchically: a Talk contains Sections, each Section contains one or more Takes
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Lap datatype with section: string field
claims.details: The Lap datatype includes a section field allowing laps to be grouped by section name.

claims.text: Each lap can be labeled with a section name after it is recorded
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Apply case LabelLap: m.laps[idx := m.laps[idx].(section := name)]
claims.details: LabelLap action updates the section field of an existing lap.

claims.text: All takes are preserved with their timestamps and durations
claims.details: LapsValid ensures all laps maintain valid timestamps and durations. StepPreservesInv proves this across all actions.

claims.text: Users can manually select which takes to include in the final talk total
claims.details: SelectLap action toggles the selected field, proven by SelectLapToggles lemma.

claims.text: Users can delete unwanted or noisy takes (without affecting other takes' durations)
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.DeletePreservesDurations ensures: forall i | 0 <= i < idx :: Apply(m, DeleteLap(idx)).laps[i].duration == m.laps[i].duration
claims.details: DeletePreservesDurations lemma proves that deleting a lap preserves all other laps' durations.

claims.text: Users can manually adjust the duration of any take
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.AdjustOnlyChangesDuration ensures: Apply(m, AdjustDuration(idx, dur)).laps[idx].duration == dur
claims.details: AdjustDuration action sets duration to the specified value, proven by AdjustOnlyChangesDuration.

claims.text: Total estimated talk duration is computed by summing the selected takes
claims.details: SelectedTotal function sums SelectedDurations, proven correct by SelectedTotalCorrect lemma.

claims.text: Selected total equals sum of selected lap durations
claims.details: SelectedTotalCorrect lemma directly proves this equality.

claims.text: Selected total is non-negative when all durations are non-negative
claims.details: SelectedTotalNonNegative lemma proves the total is non-negative given LapsValid.

claims.text: Moving a lap up swaps it with the previous lap
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.MoveUpSwaps ensures: Apply(m, MoveUp(idx)).laps[idx-1] == m.laps[idx] && Apply(m, MoveUp(idx)).laps[idx] == m.laps[idx-1]
claims.details: MoveUpSwaps lemma proves the swap behavior for MoveUp action.

claims.text: Moving a lap down swaps it with the next lap
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.MoveDownSwaps ensures: Apply(m, MoveDown(idx)).laps[idx] == m.laps[idx+1] && Apply(m, MoveDown(idx)).laps[idx+1] == m.laps[idx]
claims.details: MoveDownSwaps lemma proves the swap behavior for MoveDown action.

claims.text: Moving preserves all lap data (duration, label, selection, expected)
claims.details: The swap preserves complete Lap objects (all fields), proven by MoveUpSwaps and MoveDownSwaps.

claims.text: Moving the first lap up has no effect
claims.details: MoveUpFirstNoEffect lemma proves MoveUp(0) returns unchanged model.

claims.text: Moving the last lap down has no effect
claims.details: MoveDownLastNoEffect lemma proves MoveDown on last lap returns unchanged model.

claims.text: Starting practice captures section labels as a template queue
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.Apply case SetTemplate: Model(m.currentTime, m.lastLapTime, m.laps, labels, labels)
claims.details: SetTemplate action stores the template in both template and originalTemplate fields.

claims.text: Each lap in practice mode consumes one template entry
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateDecreasesQueue proves template length decreases by exactly one.

claims.text: Consumed template entry sets the lap's section label
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateSetsLabel lemma proves section is set from template entry.

claims.text: Consumed template entry sets the lap's expected duration
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateSetsExpected lemma proves expectedDuration is set from template.

claims.text: Consumed template entry sets the lap's tags
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateSetsTags lemma proves tags are set from template entry.

claims.text: Template queue length decreases by one after consumption
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateDecreasesQueue directly proves this property.

claims.text: Consuming template sets all fields (section, selected, tags, expected) from entry
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.ConsumeTemplateRoundTrip ensures: result.laps[idx].section == entry.section && result.laps[idx].selected == true && result.laps[idx].tags == entry.tags && (entry.expectedDuration >= 0 ==> result.laps[idx].expectedDuration == entry.expectedDuration)
claims.details: ConsumeTemplateRoundTrip lemma proves all fields are set correctly.

claims.text: Consuming template preserves original lap duration
claims.details: ConsumeTemplatePreservesDuration lemma proves duration is unchanged.

claims.text: Consuming template preserves original lap timestamp
claims.details: ConsumeTemplatePreservesTimestamp lemma proves timestamp is unchanged.

claims.text: Reset in practice mode restores ORIGINAL template as laps (not remaining)
claims.details: ResetRestoresOriginalTemplate proves laps are restored from originalTemplate.

claims.text: Reset in practice mode clears both template and originalTemplate (exits practice mode)
claims.details: ResetClearsTemplate proves both template fields are cleared.

claims.text: Reset in practice mode: each restored lap has correct section from original template
claims.details: ResetRestoresCorrectSections lemma proves section preservation for each index.

claims.text: Reset in practice mode: each restored lap has correct tags from original template
claims.details: ResetRestoresCorrectTags lemma proves tags preservation for each index.

claims.text: Importing laps preserves existing laps
claims.obligation: TalkTimer.ImportPreservesExisting ensures: forall i | 0 <= i < |m.laps| :: Apply(m, ImportLaps(laps)).laps[i] == m.laps[i]
claims.details: ImportPreservesExisting proves all existing laps are unchanged after import.

claims.text: Imported laps are appended to the end of the lap list
claims.details: ImportAppendsToEnd proves the length increases by the number of imported laps.

claims.text: Import is atomic (single undo removes all imported laps)
claims.details: ImportLaps is a single action; Kernel's undo/redo system handles it atomically via UndoRedoRoundTrip.

claims.text: All lap, label, select, and delete actions support undo and redo operations
claims.details: Kernel module provides undo/redo for all actions via UndoRedoRoundTrip and RedoUndoRoundTrip lemmas.

claims.text: The undo/redo stack preserves complete action history for the session
claims.details: HistInv is preserved by all operations (Do, Undo, Redo), proven by respective lemmas.
